findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "run_dataset" is 6292 chars, far longer than this server's median (1205). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, verify_receipt, validate_series, find_model, find_flip · Private data: describe_card, run_trajectory, describe_solver, run_dataset, verify_dataset · Public sink: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, verify_receipt, validate_series, cite, find_model, find_flip · Destructive: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, validate_series, find_flip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, verify_receipt, validate_series, find_model, find_flip · Private data: describe_card, run_trajectory, describe_solver, run_dataset, verify_dataset · Public sink: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, verify_receipt, validate_series, cite, find_model, find_flip · Destructive: verify_step, run_trajectory, verify_tape, solve, verify_solution, run_dataset, verify_dataset, validate_series, find_flip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
